scope: Complete local reader portal, collection/storage/processing, optional source-grounded AI editorial pipeline, manual picks, local administration and in-service scheduling; live model not configured; no public hosting.

upstream.name: NewsNow
upstream.usage: Whole web project and source adapters; existing db0/better-sqlite3 dependencies

upstream.name: TrendRadar
upstream.usage: Original DataFetcher.fetch_data, RSSFetcher.fetch_feed, RSSParser and ArticleReaderTools.read_article

upstream.name: Trafilatura
upstream.usage: Existing main-text extractor as fallback when upstream Jina reader is unavailable

upstream.name: RapidFuzz
upstream.usage: fuzz.ratio and process.extract for title candidate retrieval

new_code: Integration adapters, storage/import/query, derived processing, editorial policy and validation, digest history, local orchestration and tests
licenses: Retain original LICENSE files; collector imports GPL TrendRadar code. See vendor/TrendRadar/LICENSE and web/LICENSE.

dependency_layout.node_modules: Installed locally with the committed web/pnpm-lock.yaml; no dependency directory is committed
dependency_layout.python: Repository-local .runtime/python-env, installed from collector/requirements.lock.txt and vendored TrendRadar

processing.manual_corrections: local CLI only, audited and reversible
processing.zenfeed: grouping design reference only; no Go code copied

editorial.entrypoint: editorialize.ps1, called after process.ps1 by run.ps1
editorial.model_state: not_configured; no real model request or production AI analysis

direct_ui_reuse: TanStack Router and React Query already in NewsNow
portal.upstream_changes: No vendor/TrendRadar source edits; NewsNow integration, metadata and routes modified locally.

distribution.runtime_state: Excluded from Git; generated per installation
distribution.sanitized_upstream_docs: Slack webhook example URLs replaced with placeholders for GitHub push protection; reused Python source files and license texts unchanged.
